product_metadata.title: Jerry & Maggie - Photo Frame 19x22 Black Picture Frame Selfie Gallery Collage Wall Hanging for 6x4 Photo - 12 Photo Sockets - Wall Mounting Design
features: FUNCTION - Multi picture frame 4x6 collage, there are two ways to hang, assembly required, installation tools included with the package. After assembly, it can be hung vertically in the bedroom or horizontally in the living room. The wall memory display frame adapts to a variety of occasions.

DESIGN - Wall Decoration Frames for Living Room Photo Frames assembled with 3D staggered visual effect, there have 12 independent photo frames, can be placed 4X6 inch pictures, border width 1 inch. There are 4 independent hooks at the back for easy hanging.

MATERIAL - This collage picture frame uses MDF material, like wood, can water- and soil-proofing, durable while increasing the beauty; with acrylic front cover, not only can prevent dust, but also prevent photos from being scratched, more durable than glass, the edges are polished to prevent scratches. Then arrange the photos and put them in, hanging on the balcony wall, the design is integrated with the home design.

CONSTRUCT - Twelve individual photo frames, paired with instructions and installation tools, are labeled inside with installation steps and easy-to-follow instructions to help you be able to quickly perfect this collage photo frame that will showcase the details of your life.

EXCLUSIVE LOOK - You can choose wood framed pictures for living room wall decoration to hang horizontally or vertically on the wall or gallery; fully display your life and your family in your living room, bedroom, den, baby's room, etc.; perfect as gifts for family, friends, elders, and co-workers on Thanksgiving, Christmas, birthdays, and holidays.
